what: Three native frames beside one rectangle screen: a frame with no name and a 24px heading, an empty named frame, and a named frame whose 'Next' button crosses its right edge by 40px (frameId set) and whose 'Drawn without frameId' text sits inside it with no frameId.
why: Pins the edges of ADR-003's reading (SPEC-005, questions 2 to 4). The frame's name is the screen's label; an unnamed frame falls back to its heading; an empty frame is a screen, not a `shape` outside every screen; a member that pokes out belongs to its frame by frameId, since the editor clips it there; an element with no frameId nests by geometry. The rectangle screen beside them must read exactly as rectangle screens always have.

lint.why: Drawn to show a member that pokes out of its frame (SPEC-005 test case 4): it reads inside its screen, and the lint says the editor hides the 40px outside (SPEC-008).

notes: Drawn through the CLI on a canvas on port 3071 and exported, 2026-11-16. Before the reading knew frames it read: e01 'Profile', e03 'Clipped and free' (its heading, not its name), e02 as `shape` outside every screen, and e03-next outside every screen.
The 1 inferred is e03-card (card?), as any undeclared card reads.
